n.no: Keyboard, pointer, touch and assistive-technology entry point. Client architecture only; backend internals are external dependencies.

c.responsibility: Design a reusable responsive photo gallery with a full-screen lightbox and carousel navigation. Metadata and image variants come from a server. Focus on image loading, layout stability, keyboard use and cleanup after long browsing.
c.contract: props: identity, locale and initial data; events: selection, change, retry; local contract below
c.rendering: 2,000 metadata entries; fetch 30 thumbnails/page; lightbox prefetch only previous/next.
c.accessibility: Use meaningful alt text, keyboard next/previous, an accessible modal with Escape, trapped focus and focus restoration to the opened thumbnail; respect reduced motion.

n.no: Coordinates this feature. Use responsive image sizes with intrinsic width/height; lazy-load below-fold thumbnails and preload at most adjacent lightbox images. Keep the selected photo by stable ID; do not automatically advance a carousel without pause and user control. Alternative: A static grid is simpler and avoids modal navigation complexity. Preloading all full-resolution photos is wasteful even if metadata is small.
